_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: 2 segments (Cable=Fox News top > Television=Tubi), puis revenus par type (Affiliate récurrent > Advertising cyclique), puis Total.

kpis.signal: Pilier FOX. Fox News Channel + Fox Business + FS1/FS2. Affiliate fees premium + advertising solide.
kpis.description_fr: Programmation cable: Fox News (joyau), Fox Business, FS1/FS2 sports. Affiliate fees + advertising.
kpis.description_en: Cable programming: Fox News (jewel), Fox Business, FS1/FS2 sports. Affiliate + advertising.

kpis.signal: Fox Broadcasting + 28 stations locales + Tubi. Tubi ad-supported streaming = high growth.
kpis.description_fr: Television: Fox Network broadcast, 28 stations locales, Tubi (FAST ad-supported, hypercroissance).
kpis.description_en: Television: Fox Network broadcast, 28 local stations, Tubi (FAST ad-supported, hypergrowth).

kpis.signal: Récurrent. Fees payées par MVPDs (cable/sat) + virtual MVPDs. Resilient malgré cord-cutting.
kpis.description_fr: Affiliate fees: distributeurs (Comcast, DirecTV, YouTube TV, Hulu Live) paient FOX par sub.
kpis.description_en: Affiliate fees: distributors (Comcast, DirecTV, YouTube TV, Hulu Live) pay FOX per sub.

kpis.signal: Publicité cable + broadcast + Tubi. Tubi en hyper-growth. Cycle politique élections US 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Publicité: Fox News (politique boost 2024), broadcast (sports), Tubi (digital fast growth).
kpis.description_en: Advertising: Fox News (2024 election boost), broadcast (sports), Tubi (digital fast growth).

kpis.signal: CA total. FY25 boost Super Bowl + élections. Cycle pair years toujours plus haut.
kpis.description_fr: CA consolidé. FY25 = Super Bowl + élections présidentielles US (+political ad spending).
kpis.description_en: Consolidated revenue. FY25 = Super Bowl + US presidential election (political ad spending).

_notes: Fox Corporation. Fiscal year ends end June. FY25 = year ended June 30, 2025.
